caseNameFull: Mazer, doing business as June Lamp Manufacturing Co. v. Stein, doing business as Reglor of California
attorneys: Max R. Kraus and Robert L. Kahn for petitioners.

opinions.text: C. A. 4th Cir. Certiorari granted. The Solicitor General is invited to file a brief setting forth, along with other matters he deems pertinent, the views of the Copyright Office and a statement of its relevant practice.
